command:
for d in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do printf "
%s
" "$d"; cat "$d/type" "$d/temp"; done; for d in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*; do printf "
%s
" "$d"; readlink -f "$d/device"; for f in "$d"/name "$d"/temp*_input "$d"/temp*_crit "$d"/temp*_max "$d"/temp*_label "$d"/in*_input "$d"/in*_label "$d"/curr*_input "$d"/curr*_label "$d"/power*_input "$d"/power*_label "$d"/fan*_input; do if test -r "$f"; then printf "%s: " "$f"; cat "$f"; fi; done; done; cat /sys/devices/platform/firmware:zynqmp-firmware/last_reset_reason; journalctl -b -p warning --no-pager -n 100
